title: Health Connect measurement
purpose: Represent an optional repository measurement without making health a foundation dependency.

expected.semantic_interpretation: An optional health-repository measurement is ordinary evidence in the foundation envelope.
expected.opportunity: No opportunity claim is required for this fixture.
expected.time: Phenomenon, observation/result, and ingestion times remain distinct fields.
expected.provenance: Source identity and capture/procedure provenance remain explicit.
expected.raw_derived: Evidence kind is explicit and does not imply a pattern.
expected.lineage: No correction, deletion, or supersession is asserted.
expected.must_not_infer: Do not infer health status, diagnosis, treatment, or a behavioral pattern.
